mentions.name: TTRPG Narrative Engine
mentions.description: This tool is a session prep platform for tabletop RPG game masters, built as a narrative engine rather than a static wiki. It supports interconnected world-building (NPCs, factions, locations) and story-building (situations, fronts, clocks), with bidirectional linking so a story hook connected to an NPC is visible from that NPC's view. It includes a clock system with milestone consequences that can spawn or edit entities, situations that fire different consequences depending on player outcomes, and material waste detection that flags under-connected prepped-but-unused content. The main workflow is mindmap-based, with each entity getting its own context layer of direct relationships. Planned work includes automatic player-facing content that publishes public notes from involved entities as players complete situations, replacing a separate campaign log. Built with TypeScript, Effect-TS, SolidJS, Cytoscape, and Leaflet.
mentions.problem: Most existing tools are great for storing lore, but they don't help you run the story; the goal is a "create now, refine later" workflow that gets ideas into structure fast and can be refined during play.
mentions.audience: Tabletop RPG game masters and anyone who preps campaigns
